summary: Stand up a private search engine you own: a meta-search UI that aggregates existing engines with no tracking, plus your own crawl-extract-index pipeline for the corpora you care about. All five layers are real, deployable open-source projects.

capabilities.capability: meta-search front-end (aggregate existing engines, privacy proxy)
web crawler / scraper (build your own index)

capabilities.query: trafilatura html article main content extraction
meilisearch full text search engine self hosted

build_steps.title: Stand up the meta-search UI
build_steps.detail: Deploy SearXNG (Docker) for instant privacy-respecting search across 200+ engines, no crawling required. This alone is a usable private search engine.
uses: meta-search front-end (aggregate existing engines, privacy proxy)

build_steps.title: Crawl the corpora you want to own
build_steps.detail: Point Scrapy (or Crawlee) at the sites/domains you want your own index of, respecting robots.txt and rate limits.
uses: web crawler / scraper (build your own index)

build_steps.title: Extract clean text
build_steps.detail: Run each fetched page through trafilatura to strip nav/boilerplate down to main content + metadata worth indexing.

build_steps.title: Index it
build_steps.detail: Push the extracted documents into Meilisearch (or Typesense) for fast, typo-tolerant full-text search.

build_steps.title: Query from your app
build_steps.detail: Use the Meilisearch client (Python or JS) to search your index from a UI or API, or wire it as a SearXNG engine so both live behind one box.
